english.title: Ride in a rear passenger seat in a motor vehicle on a road and fail to wear seat belt
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) rode in a rear seat of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst not wearing an adult belt in conformity with regulation 5(1)(c) of the Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

failed to wear adult seat belt

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 5(1) does not apply to a person under the age of 14 years, for the offence wording see: H3048.
(ii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was a passenger in a rear seat of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) and was not wearing a seat belt.
